<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Tetris</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        body {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            color: #fff;
        }
        
        .game-container {
            display: flex;
            gap: 30px;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        
        .board-container {
            position: relative;
        }
        
        #game-board {
            border: 4px solid #4a9eff;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #0a0a1a;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.3);
        }
        
        .side-panel {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 20px;
            min-width: 150px;
        }
        
        .panel-box {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        
        .panel-box h3 {
            color: #4a9eff;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        
        .panel-box .value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #fff;
        }
        
        #next-piece {
            width: 100px;
            height: 100px;
            border: 2px solid #4a9eff;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #0a0a1a;
        }
        
        .controls {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            font-size: 12px;
            line-height: 1.8;
        }
        
        .controls h3 {
            color: #4a9eff;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        
        .controls kbd {
            background: rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.3);
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.5);
        }
        
        .game-over {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
            padding: 40px 60px;
            border-radius: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            display: none;
            border: 2px solid #ff4444;
        }
        
        .game-over h2 {
            color: #ff4444;
            font-size: 32px;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }
        
        .game-over p {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 18px;
        }
        
        .game-over button {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff4444, #ff6666);
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 30px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: white;
            font-size: 16px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        
        .game-over button:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }
        
        .start-screen {
            position: absolute;
